name: Casper Mountain County Park - Deer Haven Campground
note: Natrona County campground on Casper Mountain, across Casper Mountain Road from Beartrap: dirt sites on two short roads under pines and aspens, each with a fire ring and picnic table. The county publishes no site lengths and the spurs sit under heavy canopy, so confirm with the Parks Department that a 23-ft rig fits. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Natrona County Parks Rec1 catalog (secure.rec1.com/WY/natrona-county-wy/catalog, public getTabs/getItems/getLocationFacilities JSON, tab 12056 'Casper Mountain', group 24878 'Deer Haven', read 2026-11-20): 'Deer Haven is located across from Beartrap campground off of Casper Mountain Road ... Deer Haven has 11 campsites. Each site has a fire ring and a picnic table. $13.39 a night plus taxes and fees', 'Reservation Only', 'Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027'; 11 bookable items DH Site 01-11 at a 2026 'Nightly Rate' of $13.39. The Dyrt (deerhaven-campground-wy, read 2026-11-20): site types 'RV Sites' and 'Tent Sites', 'Drive-In: Park next to your site', reviews Aug 2023 and Jun 2026. County silent on rig length -> kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; no agency road warning found (county pages 403, unread). Google Maps 'Deer Haven campground' at 42.73196,-106.31004, 4.4 on 7 reviews, no phone. Public (local): no price gate.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-20: Esri World Imagery frames rendered at 42.7325,-106.3115 (~1 km), 42.7322,-106.3095 (~400 m) and 42.7322,-106.3108 (~270 m): dense pine/aspen forest on the Casper Mountain plateau with two dirt campground roads east of Casper Mountain Road, Beartrap Meadow to the west and cabins to the east; no lake, pond or stream visible anywhere in the 1 km frame. Rec1 describes only woods ('beautifully wooded area surrounded by pine trees and aspens'). -> not waterfront.
fees_source: Rec1 group 24878 'Deer Haven' ('$13.39 a night plus taxes and fees'); getLocationFacilities: all 11 sites 'Nightly Rate' base_fee 13.39, 2026-01-01..2026-12-31, read 2026-11-20.

Toilet type (vault/flush) not stated anywhere read.

season.note: Reopens May 28, 2027; the county does not publish a closing date.

season_source: Rec1 group 24878 ('Closed for winter. Reopens 5/28/2027.'), read 2026-11-20.

booking.note: Reservation only, online (Rec1) or through the county Parks Department.

booking_source: Rec1 group 24878 ('Reservation Only. Reservations available 90 days in advance.') + tab 12056 ('Casper Mountain Campgrounds are by reservation only'); Rec1 site photos (DH Site 01-11, shot 2022) show each site's sign '10 DAY CAMPING LIMIT ... RESERVATIONS REQUIRED', read 2026-11-20.
flags: Rig fit unverified: the county publishes no site lengths; Rec1's site photos show only the site-number signs (DH7/DH10 show dirt pads with table and fire ring), and imagery shows narrow dirt roads under heavy canopy. Kept with a caveat under the AWH 2026-11-02 unclear-pad rule; the reviewer may prefer to hold it. The Dyrt lists 'RV Sites' and 'Drive-In'; no review names a rig.

Sits ~360 m from 6530 Beartrap, across Casper Mountain Road with its own entrance road and sign; a separately named Rec1 facility with its own 11 sites, so added as its own entry (separate-booking-facility precedent, AWH 2026-10-26) rather than a duplicate.

Pin is a cleared spot with a parked vehicle at the east end of the northern campground road (~40 m NE of Google's pin 42.73196,-106.31004); site positions under the canopy are not visible, and the county map PDF (natronacounty-wy.gov DocumentCenter/View/6377) was not fetched (site refuses).

The Dyrt prose says wet-weather access can be rough, and a Jun 2026 reviewer called the drive up 'a little dicey' in autumn rain; neither is the county, so no road caveat was written. The visitcasper.com blog's 2024 warning about road construction on the mountain is dated.
Google Maps' 7 reviews mix in Saratoga's Deer Haven RV Park (one review praises 'the owners'); the 4.4 rating is not this campground's alone.
Toilet type not sourced, so facilities carries only potable_water false.
